body: Batch helpers for the notifier — optional extra headers on send and on enqueue.

expected.note: the default list is created once at import and shared by every call, so failures accumulate across calls
shared mutable default leaks recipients across calls and grows unbounded in memory

files.patch:
@@ -2,3 +2,10 @@
     headers = dict(extra_headers or {})
     headers["X-Batch"] = "1"
     return _dispatch(recipients, headers)
+
+
+def send_with_retries(recipients, attempted=[]):
+    for recipient in recipients:
+        if not _dispatch([recipient], {}):
+            attempted.append(recipient)
+    return attempted

must_not_find.note: None sentinel with a fresh dict per call; this is the correct pattern

summary: A mutable default argument next to a correct None default.
title: Add batch helpers to the notifier
